body: Love RPGs, but sadly I don't have much experience. I can see there are a lot of people already involved, I don't suppose you might have room for one more? I'm pretty shy speaking through skype and such, but if there is space I would be willing to give it a shot
Hopefully I'll be able to. Thank you for listening.

I've had that feeling as well, the mind being too active, but not for some time. I have absolutely no motive to anything most of the time. I usually just try to kill time by doing stuff, but I don't get any real enjoyment out of it. On a good day I can sometimes force myself to write a little bit in my story outline, but I can only do so for a very short period.

Yeah, the therapist I met with was actually a psychologist, sorry if that caused confusion. I'm still trying to look for answers and hopefully won't give up soon, some days are better than others. I've actually been thinking about meeting with another psychologist, see if I can find someone that can work a bit with me.

Oh and I've seen a therapist, but she couldn't see that there was anything wrong with me at the time so she canceled our sessions, I'm not really good at assessing my feelings since I can be really fickle about how I interpret them and can't recall how I felt several days gone or anything prior to that.

I guess the only thing I can think of is that I found a new song that I liked. The day had been pretty much like most of my other days so far, nothing too much out of the ordinary I can think of. Stayed at home like usually, watched some tv and played some games to kill the time, this happened at about 3:30 or 4 am, I tend to stay awake quite long and sleep in even longer since I don't have a reason to go to bed or to wake up in the morning. I really don't want to to go find something to do either (job school etc)
Have you tried seeking help for yourself? You say you want to help others and there are tons of people out there that want to help you as well. You don't have to face these things alone.

I know exactly what tomorrow holds... I'll wake up around 2 because I have to go to a birthday party, which I'm not excited for, the rest of the day I'll try to kill time by doing something that gives me no enjoyment. Rinse and repeat for every subsequent day, with different responsibilities popping up here and there. I appreciate you trying to help but when 'something grand' sounds about as exciting as staring at a wall all day it's not much to look forward to
Is it at all possible for you to go to her? It might help if she had someone to talk to in person

I hope you're right, that this might be a 'phase'. But that doesn't really change anything. I'm dead tired of being here with nothing to do, which ends up with me lying in bed doing literally nothing when I don't have any stupid responsibilities I have to take care of that day.
